analyst_view.overall: Early view: Atletico Madrid are only 23rd with 4 points after a 2-0 home defeat by Bayern, and they then lost 2-1 to Barcelona in LaLiga, with Diego Simeone saying Julian Alvarez must get back to his best. Viking (22nd, 4 points) beat Sabah 4-1 on matchday 4 and held Bayern earlier, so they arrive with confidence. Atletico need this win badly to climb back towards the play-off places.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.9 goals and I lean lower. Atletico failed to score at home to Bayern and managed one goal against Barcelona, with Alvarez missing chances. Simeone's sides rarely let games get very open, and Viking have shown they can frustrate a top side.

corners.text: The numbers say 12 corners, which already reflects Atletico pressing a deep Viking side. When Atletico struggle to break teams down they do win many corners, so I see no reason to move the figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. Atletico had only one player booked against Bayern (Giuliano Simeone), and Viking had two booked against Sabah. I found nothing that moves the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 31 shots. Atletico will have long spells on the ball and take many shots, but some will come from long range against a packed defence. I stay with the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target and I lean slightly lower. Simeone has said Alvarez is not at his best yet, and Atletico's finishing against Bayern and Barcelona was poor. Viking's Erik Botheim scored twice against Sabah, so the visitors should get a few efforts on target too.
